reply.text: {"say":"Back day built for width: lats lead with pulldowns and pull-ups, with one row to close the upper back.","title":"Back Day - Width","days":[{"name":"Back","exercises":[{"key":"wide-grip-cable-lat-pulldown","sets":4,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pull the bar to upper chest, elbows down and out."},{"key":"pull-up","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Full dead hang at the bottom, chest up at the top."},{"key":"neutral-grip-cable-lat-pulldown","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Keep the torso still, squeeze the lats at the bottom."},{"key":"straight-arm-cable-pulldown","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Arms nearly straight, drive the bar down with the lats."},{"key":"chest-to-bar-pull-up","sets":3,"reps":5,"repsTo":8,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pull the chest toward the bar, control the lowering."},{"key":"single-arm-cable-row","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Keep the shoulder packed, row the elbow back along the side."}]}],"unmet":[]}
